projections.description: NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C LABOR CATEGORY 55: DEMO TEAM COMMUNICATION PROFESSIONAL – CONTRACTOR SUPPORT FOR SMC DIRECTORATE Location: Brussels, Belgium – On-site Number of Candidates: One Candidate Period of Performance: Base Period: Contract Award – 31 December 2026 Option Period 1: 1 January 2027 – 31 December 2027 Option Period 2: 1 January 2028 – 31 December 2028 Option Period 3: 1 January 2029 – 31 December 2029 Taskings: 1. Strategic Messaging and Narrative Development : Develop clear, concise, and persuasive messages that translate Command priorities into coherent narratives for defined audiences. Ensure messaging reflects Command goals, values, and brand identity. 2. Stakeholder Communications Planning: Plan communications content for NATO leadership, Nations, NATO HQs, and external stakeholders. Define the intended audience, communication objective, key message, and appropriate channel for each activity. 3. Content Production Coordination: Coordinate with ACT/SMC, subject matter experts, graphic designers, videographers, social media staff, and creative media teams to turn approved messages into written, visual, and digital products. 4. Brand and Guidance Compliance: Review communications products to ensure they comply with applicable direction and guidance, use a consistent Command voice, and maintain visual and editorial coherence across channels. 5. Crisis Communications Support: Assist in preparing time-sensitive communications products and advice during crises or emerging issues, supporting rapid, accurate, transparent, and coordinated responses. 6. Event and Initiative Communications Support : Provide communications support for events, project launches, and initiatives, including event -specific messaging, speaker support material, audience information products, and post -event communication requirements. 7. Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor communications outputs and engagement results, assess effectiveness against agreed objectives, track stakeholder feedback where available, and provide regular reports to leadership. NATO UNCLASSIFIED RFP-ACT-SACT-26-02C Essential Qualifications 1. A degree in a relevant field such as Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field. 2. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in marketing, communications, public relations /public affairs. 3. Minimum of 2 years’ experience in crafting strategic, results driven campaigns. 4. Minimum of 2 years’ working with multinational, cross -functional teams, including subject matter experts, graphic designers, videographers, and PR professionals. 5. Proficiency with marketing and communication tools, media engagements, and project management software, including management reporting. 6. Experience with managing and fostering relationships across all levels. Desirable Qualifications 1. Experience working in military organizations and/or with military audiences. 2. projections.title: 2025/210 Subministrament d’equipament tècnic de telemetria i geolocalització pel projecte “reducing bycatch of threatened megafaunta in the east central atlantic” (REDUCE)
projections.description: El projecte REDUCE és un projecte europeu liderat per la Universitat de Barcelona i té com a objectiu utilitzar un enfocament científic interdisciplinari i unificar els esforços de les parts interessades per reduir les captures accidentals de la megafauna marina per part de les flotes europees que operen a la regió occidental de l’Atlàntic central. El projecte s’estructura en 9 diferents paquets de treball o Work Packages. Per al correcte desenvolupament del projecte resulta indispensable l’adquisició d’equipament tècnic especialitzat. En concret, el projecte requereix l’adquisició d’un ampli ventall de dispositius de monitoratge tant en embarcacions com en aus marines. Inclouen GPS de diverses mides i pesos, alguns amb acceleròmetres, radar o receptor AIS per captar interaccions amb vaixells, així com models amb alimentació solar o transmissió 4G o satel·litària que permeten seguiment en temps real o de llarga durada. La contractació d’aquests subministraments respon a la necessitat d’assoliment dels objectius de recerca del projecte Reducing bycatch of threatened megafauna in the East Central Atlantic (REDUCE) dirigit pel Dr. Jacob González-Solís Bou, catedràtic del Departament de Biologia Evolutiva, Ecologia i Ciències Ambientals de la Universitat de Barcelona. El projecte, amb Grant Agreement núm. 101135583 i finançat per la Comissió Europea HORIZON-CL6-2023-BIODIV-01 té com a objectiu principal utilitzar un enfocament científic interdisciplinari i unificar els esforços de les parts interessades per a reduir la captura incidental de fauna marina i informar i promoure la gestió sostenible de la pesca a l'oceà Atlàntic central oriental.
